# Verity Guide (veritysgame.xyz)

> Fan-made companion site for the Roblox game Verity by The ROBO Studio! (28M+ visits). All 6 badges, Good Ending book locations, full 3-day walkthrough, characters and lore — plus the wider Verity universe (Verity's Game, Build Base to Survive VERITY, Escape Verity) tracked with live Roblox data.

## Key Pages

- /badges — All 6 badges with live Roblox award counts (Bority is the rarest at ~39K awards)
- /good-ending — All 6 book locations including the hidden black book, lab sequence and freeze-bug workaround
- /walkthrough — Day-by-day 3-day survival walkthrough with resource counts
- /characters — Verity, Falsity, Barity, Lovity and Bority explained
- /veritys-game — Verity's Game (Slime Time Studios) guide plus the full Verity ecosystem compared
- /which-verity — Disambiguation: eight Roblox games use the Verity name, compared with live player counts
- /faq — Every common question answered (badges, endings, story, codes, other Verity games)
- /codes — Code status for every Verity game (only Build Base to Survive VERITY has working codes)

## Data Policy

Badge counts and game statistics come from the Roblox public APIs. Gameplay details are sourced from
full-playthrough video subtitles and community verification. Unverified claims are explicitly marked as unverified.
